description: This file defines React components for displaying and managing properties of notes within the Notesnook application, including editing note metadata, linking notes, and related actions.

classes.name: EditorProperties
classes.description: React component for displaying and editing properties of a note session.

classes.name: InternalLinks
classes.description: Component managing internal links (linked notes and references) for a note.

classes.name: InternalLinkItem
classes.description: Component rendering individual internal link items based on tab selection.

classes.name: LinkedNote
classes.description: Component displaying linked notes with expandable content blocks.

classes.name: ReferencedIn
classes.description: Component showing notes that reference the current note, with expandable content blocks.

classes.name: Colors
classes.description: Component for selecting and displaying note colors.

classes.name: Notebooks
classes.description: Component listing notebooks associated with a note.

classes.name: Reminders
classes.description: Component listing reminders associated with a note.

classes.name: Attachments
classes.description: Component listing attachments related to a note.

classes.name: SessionHistory
classes.description: Component displaying the history of note sessions.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Reusable layout component for sections within the properties panel.

methods.name: changeToggleState
methods.description: Function to toggle note properties such as lock, readonly, pin, favorite, archive, and local-only.
